in_sanskrit.name: Agney
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Agney is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Agni', which means 'fire'. In Hindu mythology, Agni is the god of fire and is an essential part of various rituals and ceremonies.

in_hindi.name: अग्नेय
in_hindi.long_meaning: अग्नेय नाम हिंदी में 'अग्नि' है जो 'अग्नि' केवल अग्नि का नाम है। हिंदू धर्म में अग्नि देव है जो अग्नि के साथ-साथ विवहद्वारा और पूजाद्वारा कई रितुओं तक समस्त प्रकार के विधियों में उपयोग किया जाता है।

in_tamil.name: Agnan
in_tamil.long_meaning: Agnan is the Tamil translation of the Sanskrit word 'Agni', which means 'fire'. In Hinduism, Agni is considered to be the god of fire and is an integral part of various rituals and ceremonies.

in_telugu.name: Agnina
in_telugu.long_meaning: Agnina is the Telugu translation of the Sanskrit word 'Agni', which means 'fire'. In Hinduism, Agni is considered to be the god of fire and is an essential component of various rituals and ceremonies.

in_marathi.name: Agney
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agney हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Agney is the name of the fire god in Hindu mythology. This powerful deity is responsible for the creation and maintenance of the universe. Agney represents courage, power, and purity.
